scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) For Handicraft Artisans: Assistance For Capital Investment To Uplift The Economic Condition Of Artisans/ Persons
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be engaged in any of the 27 specified activities as listed in the official guidelines
Annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000 in rural areas or ₹2,50,000 in urban areas
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for tools and equipment ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 for eligible artisans.
